records.source: 古来より伝わる遠国の賢者の{j}伝承を元に作成された重銃。{j}持ち主に風の力を宿すという。
records.previous: A Heavy Bowgun forged from the{j}legend of a sage from a distant land, handed down since ancient times.{j}It is said to imbue its wielder with the power of wind.
records.target: Heavy Bowgun from a sage's legend.{j}Passed down for ages, it is said{j}to grant its wielder wind power.

records.source: 古来より伝わる遠国の賢者の{j}伝承を元に作成された弓。{j}持ち主に風の力を宿すという。
records.previous: A Bow forged from the{j}legend of a sage from a distant land, handed down since ancient times.{j}It is said to imbue its wielder with the power of wind.
records.target: Bow from a sage's legend.{j}Passed down for ages, it is said{j}to grant its wielder wind power.

records.source: 古の装飾が施された黒い軽弩。{j}儀礼用であったものを鍛え、{j}至高の逸品へと昇華した。
records.previous: A black Light Bowgun adorned with ancient ornamentation.{j}Forged from what was once ceremonial,{j}it was elevated into a supreme masterpiece.
records.target: Black Light Bowgun with ancient ornament.{j}Forged from a ceremonial weapon into{j}a supreme masterpiece.

records.source: 東方の極楽に住まう神々の戦{j}装束を模した胴用装備。浮岳{j}龍の素材と伝説の技術の結晶。
records.previous: Body armor modeled after the battle{j}garb of the gods who dwell in the Eastern paradise. A crystallization of Yama Tsukami{j}materials and legendary craft.
records.target: Body armor modeled after Eastern gods.{j}Yama Tsukami materials and legendary{j}craft crystallized in its form.

records.source: 滑らかな光沢を持つ特殊合金{j}製の防具。金の細工が、夜空{j}を流れる星の大河を思わせる。
records.previous: Armor made from a special alloy{j}with a smooth gloss. Its goldwork calls to mind{j}a great river of stars flowing across the night sky.
records.target: Armor made from a smooth special alloy.{j}Its goldwork evokes a great river of stars{j}flowing across the night sky.

records.source: メラルーの足を模した脚用装{j}備。歩くたびに足裏から伝わ{j}る肉球の感触が好評。
records.previous: Leg equip{j}ment modeled after a Melynx's foot. The feel of the paw pads transmit{j}ted through your soles with every step is popular.
records.target: Leg gear modeled after a Melynx paw.{j}Paw pads transmit their feel through your{j}soles with every step; a popular design.

records.source: 黒きを滅ぼすという名の龍剣。{j}龍の唸りに呼応して振動し、{j}その威力を数倍に増すという。
records.previous: A dragon sword named for the destruction of blackness. It vibrates in answer to{j}a dragon's roar,{j}and is said to multiply its power severalfold.
records.target: Dragon sword that destroys darkness.{j}It vibrates to a dragon's roar and may{j}multiply its power severalfold.

records.source: 一見何の変哲もないが、盾蟹{j}素材の一等堅い部分だけを削{j}りぬいて作られた乙な片手剣。
records.previous: Though unremarkable at first glance, this tasteful Sword & Shield was made from Daimyo Hermitaur{j}materials by carving{j}away all but the hardest parts.
records.target: Tasteful Sword & Shield, plain at glance.{j}Made from Daimyo Hermitaur materials,{j}carved to retain only the hardest parts.

records.source: 銀の装飾が施された黒い穿龍{j}棍。儀礼用であったが実用性{j}も兼ね備えた至高の逸品。
records.previous: A black Tonfa{j}adorned with silver ornaments. Though it was for ceremonial use, it possesses practicality{j}as well, making it a supreme masterpiece.
records.target: Black Tonfa with silver ornaments.{j}Ceremonial yet practical, it became{j}a supreme masterpiece.

records.source: 鋼龍の素材を古の大剣に組み{j}合わせ、打ち上げた鋼大剣。{j}辺りが凍るほどの寒さを放つ。
records.previous: A steel Great Sword forged by{j}combining Kushala Daora's materials with an ancient Great Sword. It gives off{j}a cold intense enough to freeze the air around it.
records.target: Steel Great Sword combining Kushala Daora{j}materials and an ancient Great Sword.{j}Its cold can freeze the surrounding air.
